name: Hiliks Technologies Limited
about: Hiliks Technologies Limited engages in the provision of information technology services in India. The company provides hardware and software development, system networking and satellite communications, protocols, call centers, medical transcription, medical billing, system development, computer training, software development infrastructure, and networking services. It also offers manpower consulting in software; hardware and networking, and other business process outsourcing activities; training center; help desk services; and services related to products, product support, software education, system integration, embedded systems development, and software testing and support services. In addition, it offers customer relation management and enterprise resource planning software; networking solutions and software counseling and consultancy; and deals in smart cards, bio-metric, iris capturing, and data entry related solutions; and provides software counseling and consultancy, data processing, warehousing, technical auditing, and digitization services. Further, the company provides GIS solutions for urban planning, ports & logistics, and smart cities; telecom infrastructure solutions, including OFC laying, wireless solutions, and village connectivity programs; mobility solutions, such as mobile applications and platforms, and manpower solutions. Additionally, it offers railway, technology, and consulting solutions. The company was formerly known as Anubhav Industrial Resources Limited. Hiliks Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
